svg.title: Commercial fisher — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as commercial fisher, wearing a raincoat and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A hanging fish with a triangular tail and eye sits apart from a long fishing line ending in an open curved hook. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap and round glasses.
